messages.text: Shop···· does the 3x bsb gamma come with any Power Supply units included? Thank you.
Searched the catalog · BSB Bitaxe Gamma 602

Yes. The 3-pack is three complete units, and each Bitaxe Gamma comes with its own MEANWELL 5V 10A power supply (LRS-50-5) and a 3D-printed stand. That's three power supplies in total, so you don't need to buy anything else to run them.

That's from the product listing. I haven't opened Shop···· because I'd need one more detail to match it, like the name it ships to or the postcode. Send one of those if you'd like me to check the order itself.
